plan.headline: Of your $123,006 in IEEPA tariffs paid, all 40 entries appear eligible for a refund: $12,372 through CAPE now and $110,634 through protests due by Jan 12–31, 2027.

steps.title: File protests on 36 entries (earliest deadline Jan 12, 2027)
steps.detail: These 36 entries (about $110,634) were finalized more than 80 days ago, so CAPE (customs' refund portal) will reject them. They appear eligible for a protest, a formal written challenge to customs, which must be filed within 180 days (19 U.S.C. 1514). Deadlines run from Jan 12, 2027 to Jan 31, 2027, so ask your broker to start soon.

steps.title: Claim 4 entries in CAPE now
steps.detail: These 4 entries (about $12,372) appear eligible for CAPE because they are unliquidated (not yet finalized) or were finalized 80 days ago or less (CSMS #68340863). No deadline was given, but there is no reason to wait. Your broker can upload them using the CAPE file.

steps.title: Send your broker the email below and confirm the plan
steps.detail: Ask your broker to confirm each route and deadline before anything is filed.

plan.broker_email_subject: IEEPA tariff refunds: CAPE filing and protests for Driftwood Patio Co.

- DP1-6833397-5 ($3,692)

The extraction marks every entry unliquidated, but the 10/21/2026 statement shows 36 of them liquidated, with dates between 07/16/2026 and 08/04/2026. The statement has no HTS line detail, entered values or rates, so 'lines' is empty for every entry. Line detail may be on 7501 pages in other parts.
The IEEPA amounts come from the statement column 'IEEPA (9903.01/.02)'. The statement does not list the separate Chapter 99 HTS numbers.
Four entries are marked 'Open' with no liquidation date and are recorded as unliquidated: DP1-6290550-0, DP1-6449054-3, DP1-6750145-7 and DP1-6833397-5.
These pages say nothing about surety payment, protests, drawback, reconciliation, AD/CVD or a Court of International Trade case, so those values are false or null.
